text: No, the property did not lose 67.7 ha of tree cover after the EUDR cut-off date (December 31, 2020). The 67.7 ha loss occurred in 2020, before the baseline. No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 ha or larger were detected between 2021 and 2025. Small patches of loss (<0.5 ha) in 2021 were recorded but are not counted as events. The asset had no forest cover in 2020, and observability was complete for the post-baseline period.
